overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: two Board of Health members acted as Selectmen at meetings where the Health Department and noise regulations were discussed, so no Board of Health joint meeting notice was required.

allegations.summary: Board of Health members allegedly deliberated at the Selectmen's March 21 meeting on draft noise regulations without posting notice of a joint meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, the Board of Health did not deliberate on a matter within its jurisdiction and therefore no joint meeting was necessary.

allegations.summary: Board of Health allegedly failed to post notice of the Selectmen's March 30 joint budget meeting with the Finance Committee, where the Health Department budget was discussed.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that the Board of Health did not violate the Open Meeting Law by failing to post notice of the March 30 meeting.
